next_action.description: Two things are open on MPI-504 and BOTH are Fabio's calls, so ask before building. (1) THE 1k/2k QUALITY CONTROL. One declared field emits ONE value; the graph needs TWO nodes (676 Input_Width + 677 Input_Height, feeding EmptyLatentImage AND SolidMask). mapTo does not help - it is a linear range map. Three options are written up in plan.md `## Plan Drift`: an Input_Quality MpiInt behind two MpiAnySwitch banks (the Input_Recipe pattern, three nodes away, zero app code, needs a raw/ edit); a new field type whose option carries a param MAP (portable, but it is frame work in MpiBaseFlow._collectInputs, which a peer holds); or ship without it, which is where it stands - baked 1280x768. Fabio handed over the last raw/ edit rather than doing it himself, so OFFER to do it. Use 1280x800 for 1k, not 1280x768 - the ratio fix this session makes 1280x800 the true 8:5, and it makes both quality options the same shape. (2) THE OTHER FOUR FLUX RATIO ROWS. 8:5/5:8 were corrected; 3:4 is really 7:9 (3.70% off), 4:3 is 9:7, 4:5 is 14:17, 9:16 is 4:7 (1.59%). Each has an exact /16-clean value at ~1MP (864x1152, 896x1120, 720x1280; 1:1 is already exact). Offered, not answered. Then: the LIVE RUN of the flow in your own `npm run app:isolated` instance (playbook 05), and `/mpi-flow-graphics` for the tile + hero.

key_decisions: THE 8:5 FIX IS FABIO'S, AND HIS REASONING IS THE RULE: 'if 1280x800 is true 8:5, then we're lying to the user, and we should fix that.' The labels across ratios.js are otherwise nominal - 61 of 74 labelled rows deviate by >=0.5% - so the principle, if extended, reaches far past the row that was fixed. That extension is OFFERED and UNANSWERED; do not assume either way.

THE PROP SHEET IS A SEPARATE FLOW, NOT A MODE on the Character Sheet. Fabio: 'I think it's best to have a separate flow for it.' MPI-586 carries the spec - animals and props, no headless pass (so krea2 only, no klein-4b and no SAM3 chain), 8:5 AND 16:9 user-chosen, and a PLACEMENT axis with per-option guidance because the right placement is object-dependent. It hits the SAME two-nodes-one-field ratio gap, so it must reuse whatever MPI-504 settles rather than inventing a second answer.
Input_Recipe is a SELECT, not a radio - four equal looks rather than a cost ladder. The type emits the option's original `v`, so the int reaches MpiAnySwitch as a number.

The enhanced phrase is a PRODUCT, not an intermediate. It goes to Input_Positive, which beats the top-level `positive` because _buildParams assigns injectionParams LAST (commandExecutor.js:610-655). An untouched box sends the raw prompt instead.

A pending file state is PROVENANCE, NOT A WRITE LOCK. MPI-585 had released flowsRegistry.js from `claimed` to `needs_verification`, which is why taking it was legitimate. Only a fresh `claimed` record blocks a write - read both `path` and `paths` on every record.
